QuestInfo.name: Dealing with Boss Kitty
QuestInfo.0: You finally figured out what Boss Kitty said, but if you want that #bOrange Marble#k, you'll have to do something first.
QuestInfo.1: You finally figured out what Boss Kitty said, but if you want that #bOrange Marble#k, you'll have to do something first.
QuestInfo.2: Boss Kitty will only return the marble if you take his quiz, and get every single question right. But not only that, in order to even start the quiz, you'll need to bribe him with #b300 Fried Chickens#k. Cats may love birds, but this is crazy...

yes.0: Hmmm...? Do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth?

no.0: What does a human like you want from me? Get out of here unless you got something to say!

yes.0: I like pretty objects, the ones that sparkle. Sparkles won't turn their back on you like those mean humans. Sure, I stole that marble, but boo-hoo! I've been abused by humans for as long as all the other cats here. If you want your precious marble back, you'll get it on my terms. Tell you what, I'm going to ask you some questions. If you get them all right, the Orange Marble is yours. But taking my questionnaire is gonna cost you. I want #b300 fried chickens#k. And if you mess up a question, I expect another #b300 fried chickens#k to let you start again.
